entries: Nobility is often found in circumstances that cannot be avoided. Also, I wanted to blow those monsters up real badly.
高尚之举，往往出现在避无可避的处境里。再说，我确实很想把那些怪物炸上天。
Well, I don't suppose that we even know.
嗯，我看我们连这个都说不清。
...hat all you've got! Haha! Ha... ha. ... umm. Ok, what just happened?
……就这点本事！哈哈！哈……哈。……呃。好吧，刚才发生了什么？
You were turned to stone, and now you are free. It must have been one of the creatures in this place.
你被变成了石头，如今自由了。一定是这地方的某个生物干的。
Allow me to introduce myself. I am...
Who are you? Better yet, what year do you think it is?
你是谁？不如说，你以为现在是哪一年？
It was a noble thing to sacrifice yourself for the others.
为了他人牺牲自己，是高尚之举。
You seem to be out of room. Oh, don't worry about me. I have been out here many years already. Another few will not hurt me.
你们好像没空位了。哦，别为我担心。我已经在外面待了许多年。再多几年也算不了什么。
Do not forget to use the password in my note.
别忘了用我纸条上的口令。
Then I shall continue to guard these halls.
那我继续守卫这些厅堂。
Do not forget to use the password in my note.
别忘了用我纸条上的口令。
Let's see. It was the year 2750, of the Fourth Age. What year is it now?
让我想想。那是第四纪元的 2750 年。现在呢，是哪一年？
Too many names. I think Shelter is fine enough.
名字太多了。我觉得「庇护所」就挺好。
Wise words. I would not have expected such from a Scaphin, which proves me somewhat of a fool.
明智之言。我没想到会从斯卡芬，嘴里听到，这证明我多少是个傻瓜。
We shall see if Naira lets me back in after all my incessant joking.
等我这么没完没了地开玩笑之后，奈拉还肯不肯让我回去，走着瞧吧。
But first, we need that note that I left behind; the one mentioned in my... stone tablet.
但首先，我们得找到我留下的那张纸条，就是我的……石板上提到的那张。
We need to find a way to that southern entrance. The secret entrance in the library stairwell may not be enough.
我们得找到通往南边入口的路。图书馆楼梯间里的密道，也许还不够。
We may have to delve deeper into these halls if the way is blocked.
如果路被堵死，我们恐怕得往这些厅堂更深处探。
It is 2755. And I have not seen you in five years.
现在是 2755 年。而我已经五年没见过你了。
I would not go that far.
... in service of all those who seek the great Shelter. The wing of Leunamar. The bosom of Renault. The...
……为所有追寻伟大庇护所的人效力。卢纳玛尔之翼。雷诺之怀。以及……
Oh, it is quite good to see you @. Five years you say? So much time lost...
哦，见到你太好了，@。你说五年？多少光阴白白流逝……
Many thanks to you. Ah, I see that you have the note... er, stone tablet...
万分感谢。啊，看来你拿到了那张纸条……呃，石板……
No dwell on time. Past not matter. Only what do now.
别纠结时间。过去不重要。只看现在做什么。
Good to see that you have a sense of humor. I see it as an indication of a functional mind.
很高兴看到你有幽默感。在我看来，这是心智健全的标志。
Well, anyways, I was fighting out here to keep the monsters of this place from breaching Kalindraur.
总之，我一直在这外面战斗，不让此地的怪物攻破卡林德劳尔。
In the end, I sealed it behind myself because their numbers were too great. But things appear safer now.
最后，它们的数量实在太多，我便把自己连同封印一起留在了这里。不过现在看起来安全多了。
